fusions.name: Undercut
fusions.desc: A chopping claw stroke through a cone 3 tiles ahead deals 13 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Timber Fall
fusions.desc: Brings your full weight down on one target for 18 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Whetted Claws
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Clear-Cut Fury
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
